The main takeaway from our work is that

the TLR4+894A/G and CD 14-159C>T polymorphisms were associated with severe sepses in febrile de-compensated patients with cirrhosis and that these polymorphisms were related to monocyte dysfunction and dys-regulated plasma cytokine levels.
